metadata.source: Read-only inspection of Math Academy completed-task DOM in the authenticated Chrome session
metadata.selection: 22 lessons including previously analyzed examples and recent additional lessons; 20 reviews including previously analyzed examples and recent additional reviews. This is a selected sample, not the complete progress.csv history.
metadata.encoding: Each task row is [task_id, activity_type, sequences]. Each lesson sequence is one nonempty DOM .kp group in display order; reviews have one whole-task sequence. E/M/H is displayed question difficulty; C/I is displayed Correct/Incorrect. Tokens preserve observed question order.
limitations: Results pages do not expose candidate bank difficulty distributions, initial prepared questions, selection probabilities, or when question identities were selected.
An empty trailing KP in task 12601433 is excluded; its nonempty first group is retained.
Completed feed status does not establish successful mastery of every KP.
Differences by task, KP, question position, and available difficulty mix confound comparisons by preceding correctness.
No model or production-code change is made by collecting these observations.
